errors.evidence: The color used for mBERT-B₂ is pink or salmon, not light red. While it is a lighter shade compared to the dark red of XLM-B₂, 'light red' is not the most accurate description of the color itself.

In the 'gender' category, the description claims that models other than mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ hover near an effect of 1-2. This is inaccurate for the XLM-L₂ model (dark blue bar), which has an effect value of approximately 0.3, well below the 1-2 range.
